spans.s: दोह m. 1. Milking, आश्चर्यो गवां दोहोऽगोपेन S.K., K.S.i.2, R.ii.22, xvii.19; 2. milk; 3. a milk-pail.

दोहद m.n. 1. The longing of a pregnant woman, उपेत्य सा दोहददुःखशीलतां यदेव वव्रे तदपश्यदाहृतम् R.iii.6, 7, xiv.45; 2. pregnancy; 3. the desire of plants before budding, (e.g. that of the Aśoka to be touched by the foot of a beautiful girl), Megh.ii.15, R.viii.62; See वकुल; 4. violent desire; 5. desire in general.
दोहद-लक्षण n. 1. the fetus, the embryo, R.iii.1; 2. the period of passing from one season of life to another.
दोहद-वती f. a pregnant woman longing for anything.
दोहन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Milking; 2. yielding (desirable objects).
दोहन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Milking; 2. yielding (desirable objects).
दोहल m. The same as दोहद q.v., वृथा वहसि दोहलं (v.l.) ललितकामिसाधारणम् Mal.iii.
दोह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) To be milked.
दोह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) To be milked.
